declarations.name: GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.edgeOccurrences
declarations.type: {Edge : Type u_2} → Quiver.Path (Quiver.SingleObj.star Edge) (Quiver.SingleObj.star Edge) → List Edge

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.pathToList_comp
declarations.type:
∀ {Edge : Type u_2} (left : Quiver.Path (Quiver.SingleObj.star Edge) (Quiver.SingleObj.star Edge))
  {finish : Quiver.SingleObj Edge} (right : Quiver.Path (Quiver.SingleObj.star Edge) finish),
  Quiver.SingleObj.pathToList (left.comp right) = Quiver.SingleObj.pathToList right ++ Quiver.SingleObj.pathToList left

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.edgeOccurrences_reconstruct
declarations.type:
∀ {Edge : Type u_2} (edges : List Edge),
  GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.edgeOccurrences
      (Quiver.SingleObj.pathEquivList.symm edges.reverse) =
    edges

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.vertices_comp_keep_left
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : Quiver V] {a b c : V} (left : Quiver.Path a b) (right : Quiver.Path b c),
  (left.comp right).vertices = left.vertices ++ right.vertices.tail

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.distinct_occurrence_prefixes
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : Quiver V] {a b : V} (path : Quiver.Path a b) (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < path.vertices.length)
  (hj : j < path.vertices.length),
  i ≠ j →
    ∃ pi si pj sj,
      path = pi.comp si ∧
        path = pj.comp sj ∧ pi.length = i ∧ pj.length = j ∧ ⟨path.vertices[i], pi⟩ ≠ ⟨path.vertices[j], pj⟩

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.edgeOccurrences.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Edge : Type u_2} (path : Quiver.Path (Quiver.SingleObj.star Edge) (Quiver.SingleObj.star Edge)),
  GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.edgeOccurrences path =
    (Quiver.SingleObj.pathEquivList path).reverse

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.path_eq_of_vertices_eq
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : Quiver V] {a b : V} [∀ (x y : V), Subsingleton (x ⟶ y)] (left right : Quiver.Path a b),
  left.vertices = right.vertices → left = right

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.vertices_prefix_comp
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : Quiver V] {a b c : V} (left : Quiver.Path a b) (right : Quiver.Path b c),
  left.vertices <+: (left.comp right).vertices

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.vertex_position_comp
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : Quiver V] {a b c : V} (left : Quiver.Path a b) (right : Quiver.Path b c) (index : ℕ)
  (hi : index < left.vertices.length), (left.comp right).vertices[index]? = some left.vertices[index]

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.reconstruct_edgeOccurrences
declarations.type:
∀ {Edge : Type u_2} (path : Quiver.Path (Quiver.SingleObj.star Edge) (Quiver.SingleObj.star Edge)),
  Quiver.SingleObj.pathEquivList.symm
      (GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.edgeOccurrences path).reverse =
    path

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.vertices_reverse
declarations.type: ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : Quiver V] {a b : V} (path : Quiver.Path a b), path.vertices.reverse = b :: path.toList

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.split_at_occurrence
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : Quiver V] {a b : V} (path : Quiver.Path a b) (index : ℕ) (hi : index < path.vertices.length),
  ∃ initial suffix, path = initial.comp suffix ∧ initial.length = index

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.edgeOccurrences_comp
declarations.type:
∀ {Edge : Type u_2} (left right : Quiver.Path (Quiver.SingleObj.star Edge) (Quiver.SingleObj.star Edge)),
  GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.edgeOccurrences (left.comp right) =
    GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.edgeOccurrences left ++
      GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.edgeOccurrences right

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.parallel_loop_summary_counterexample

          [Quiver.SingleObj.star Bool, Quiver.SingleObj.star Bool] ∧
        (GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.parallelLoop true).vertices =
            [Quiver.SingleObj.star Bool, Quiver.SingleObj.star Bool] ∧
          (GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.parallelLoop false).vertices =
              (GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.PathOccurrences.parallelLoop true).vertices ∧
